page.overview:
What is Gulpin?

Gulpin is a green Pokémon with a black spot on its back. On top of its head, there is a "feather" that is yellow, skinny and long. Its eyes are closed, its lips are puckered, and it has small fat two-fingered hands.

Male Gulpin have a longer feather on its head than female.

Gulpin evolves into Swalot starting at level 26.
